lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings covering a cluster of new buildings in Backman Village — the kind of project that shapes what the west end of town looks like for decades. Also Tuesday, San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, this round focused on zoning, density, and regulatory incentives aimed at making workforce and affordable housing easier to build. Sprinkled through the weekend, the Hardrock Hundred rolls through and the North Mississippi Allstars hit the Sheridan Saturday night.

notable.stake: Public hearings on major multi-building Carhenge redevelopment in Backman Village.
HARC reviews alterations and floor-area addition to two Town-owned landmark buildings.
County's housing code rewrite advances zoning, density, and affordability incentive recommendations.
